post: You win here too. Fine. The sea is bigger than both of us. Let's see who crosses it first.
pre: You pick first, I pick stronger. That is the rule, and the rule has not changed.

entries.kind: outpost bedroom + lab start (chapter opening, not a new game)

lines: You are awake. Good. The lab is down the road.
The researcher is waiting, and Hex is already there, looking impatient. Go. Do not keep Hex waiting — he keeps score.
npcs.speaker: Outpost keeper, downstairs

lines: Welcome to Root Hamlet. Pick a partner from the table. It will travel with your main team, not instead of it.
Take the Mochiioteca upgrade, and the Capture Cubes. The sea is wide, and you will need both.
npcs.speaker: Region 3 researcher (lab)

entries.sprites: outpost bedroom + lab, Kenney Furniture Kit CC0 restyled

lines: This is the opening road. First route, first wilds, now open after the lab beat.
Do not skip the road. The road teaches the region's weather, and the weather matters here.
npcs.speaker: Oldale road keeper

lines: The sea starts here, even on land. You can smell it before you see it.
npcs.speaker: Oldale fisher

entries.sprites: road + shore, Kenney Tiny Town CC0 restyled

lines: The land remembers. We are here to help it remember louder.
antagonist.speaker: Land faction scout

post: Honest. Take the first badge of this region.
pre: Stone is not stubborn. Stone is honest. Show me an honest team.

lines: Stone does not hurry. Stone waits, and then it is still there when you are tired.
The first faction was seen here. Watch the stone, not the people. The stone tells you who moved it.
npcs.speaker: Rustboro stone keeper

entries.sprites: stone city, Kenney Tiny City CC0 restyled

post: You stayed. Take the second badge.
pre: An island dojo is a dojo with nowhere to run. Stand, and fight like you mean to stay.

lines: The island is across the water. Wave-Ride works here. Water is a road, if you respect it.
npcs.speaker: Dewford boat keeper

lines: The cave is dark, but it is not empty. Bring Illuminate, and bring patience. Both light the same way.
npcs.speaker: Cave guide

entries.sprites: island + cave, 0x72 CC0 + Tiny Town CC0 restyled

lines: The sea forgets. We are here to help it forget faster.
antagonist.speaker: Sea faction scout

post: You waited, then you struck. Take the third badge.
pre: Electric is fast, but fast is not first. First is the Ranger who knows when to wait.

entries.music: electric-city loop, driving, CC0 chiptune; Arena loop, driving

lines: Welcome to the Arena. First full tournament bracket in the story. Win it, and the city remembers your name.
npcs.speaker: Arena announcer

lines: The city runs bright. Bright is not the same as safe. Watch the wires, and watch the people who watch the wires.
npcs.speaker: Mauville electric keeper

entries.sprites: electric city + Arena, Kenney Tiny City CC0 restyled

lines: The land remembers. Wake it, and it will remember us first.
antagonist.speaker: Land faction leader (role only, NAME GAP for personal name)

pre: Heat does not make a Ranger strong. Heat shows which Ranger is already strong.

lines: The springs are warm because the mountain is awake. Warm is good. Awake is a warning.
Soak, rest, heal — the MochiiPlex here is warm too, and the heal is free, same as home.
npcs.speaker: Hot-spring keeper

entries.sprites: springs + volcano road, Tiny Town CC0 restyled

post: He was right. Take the fifth badge.
pre: I knew Aeon when he was still learning. He told me you would come. Show me he was right.

lines: This dojo waited for you. It was strong when you were new, and it is strong now that you are not new. That is the point of a return.
npcs.speaker: Petalburg elder

lines: A dojo leader who knew Aeon is not a test. He is a memory, with a team. Treat him like both.
npcs.speaker: Mochiko, by radio / in person if placed

entries.sprites: city, Kenney Tiny City CC0 restyled

lines: The sea forgets. The sky should forget too. We are just helping it along.
antagonist.speaker: Sea faction operative, weather institute

pre: A tree-city dojo is a dojo of balance. Lean too far, and you fall. Lean right, and you win.

lines: The weather is not weather here. It is a signal, and someone is sending it.
The Sea faction moved on the weather. Stop them, and the sky goes back to being sky.
npcs.speaker: Weather institute keeper

lines: The city is in the trees. Walk the canopy slow. A fast Ranger falls, and a fallen Ranger learns nothing.
npcs.speaker: Canopy guide

entries.sprites: tree city, Kenney Tiny Town CC0 restyled

post: You held. Take the eighth badge.
pre: A crater dojo is a dojo of pressure. Hold under pressure, and you hold anywhere.

entries.kind: Dojo 8 in canon order, Deep-Dive gate, awakening (canon order: Lilycove, Mossdeep, then this crater city)

lines: This city is under water and inside a volcano at once. That is not a contradiction. That is a balance, and balance is hard to hold.
Deep-Dive is the gate. Dive, and come back with the city, not just with yourself.
npcs.speaker: Crater city elder

entries.sprites: crater + water, 0x72 CC0 + Tiny Town CC0 restyled

lines: The land remembers. It will not share the memory with the sea.
The sea forgets. It will not share the forgetting with the land.
You: pick a side, or pick the balance. The balance is harder, and it is the only one that holds.
antagonist.speaker: Land faction operative + Sea faction operative, colliding in the hideout

entries.kind: port, hideout under the city, no dojo

lines: The port is busy, and busy hides things. The hideout is under the city. The two factions are colliding down there, not up here.
npcs.speaker: Port keeper

entries.sprites: port + hideout, Tiny City CC0 restyled + 0x72 CC0

post: You have it. Take the seventh badge.
pre: Two at once is not twice as hard. It is a different skill. Show me you have it.

flags: r3_double_battle_dojo_note: double battles are a future system in the wiring master, record that, do not claim them as wired

lines: The satellite link is not a toy. It talks to the world, and the world answers.
The double-battle dojo is here. Two creatures, one Ranger, no hiding behind a single star.
npcs.speaker: Research city keeper

entries.sprites: research city, Kenney Tiny City CC0 restyled

lines: You stopped both wakes. That is not a victory. That is a balance. Keep it.
npcs.speaker: Crater city elder, after the awakening

lines: The land woke, and it saw you. It will remember that, even if we do not.
npcs.speaker: Land faction leader (role only)

lines: The sea woke, and it saw you. It will forget us, but it will not forget you.
npcs.speaker: Sea faction leader (role only)

entries.sprites: storm + flood + fire, Tiny Town CC0 restyled

lines: Eight badges, sea and cave. That is the gate. Walk it. The League is on the other side, and it does not wait for late Rangers.
npcs.speaker: Victory gate keeper

lines: I crossed this sea in a storm. You can cross a route. Show me.
After battle: You crossed. Good. The Plateau is next.
npcs.speaker: Veteran Ranger (talk-to-battle, ROSTER GAP)

post: Balanced. The Hall remembers you three times now. The Frontier Arenas are waiting.
pre: You balanced a region that was splitting in two. Now balance me.
champion.speaker: CHAMPION — Nagisa

pre: I guard the door. The sea taught me patience. Patience teaches back.
elite.speaker: ELITE 1 (NAME GAP)

pre: I guard the stairs. The land taught me steadiness. Be steady.
elite.speaker: ELITE 2 (NAME GAP)

post: It remembers you. The champion's door is next.
pre: I guard the hall. The hall remembers every region you have walked.
elite.speaker: ELITE 3 (NAME GAP)

pre: I guard the champion's door. Knock twice, and mean it, in storm and in calm.
elite.speaker: ELITE 4 (NAME GAP)

entries.music: elite loop, champion loop, hall loop calm, CC0 chiptune

lines: Third ascent. The Hall has a third page for you, if you earn it.
npcs.speaker: Plateau attendant

entries.sprites: Plateau + Hall, Furniture Kit CC0 restyled

lines: We are moving creatures for their own good. You will see, on the other side. You will see.
antagonist.speaker: Liberation Front speaker, on the airship route

lines: Welcome to the Frontier. Singles, doubles, rental teams, streaks — each Arena has its own rule, and the rules do not bend for champions.
npcs.speaker: Frontier announcer

lines: You cleared the Frontier. The mountain pass is open. The airship route is north, over the crater range, to a colder, older region.
npcs.speaker: Arena keeper, after the last Arena

entries.sprites: Arena brackets, Tiny City CC0 restyled
